scope: Desktop cross-node/source-root input chooser, atomic A/B pairing, selected-pair canvas references, stale-reference handling, display layout and regression. Scientific algorithms and execution limits are unchanged.

build.type: Reconfigured out-of-tree build; affected targets, generated help and version-bearing targets rebuilt

focused_checks: Mouse and Enter selection of actual dataset/output references; unchanged explicit origins retained
Cross-root pair editing is a draft until confirmation; one undo/redo restores exact identities
Missing source node repair preserves pair identity; undo repairs and deletion restores previous references
Source tree excludes joint paths; data filtering cannot silently choose another row; duplicate names are distinguished
Workflow/source revisions, document destruction and running locks reject stale dialogs
Cancel input or pair dialogs without mutation; immediate reopening before deferred deletion
Current pair has at most two reference paths; pair switching, descendant selection, missing-reference badges and undo
Existing real Welch direct/linked/preview/persistence equivalence regression retained
1000-row pair editor uses delegate cells and one on-demand candidate model; cancel preserves all original pairs
Chinese/English, light/dark, normal/narrow windows and 100/125/200 percent display scaling

local_performance_sample.operation: Open pair editor, open a member chooser, select another dataset, prepare draft; original pairs retained after cancel
local_performance_sample.kind: single offscreen sample on this host; not a cross-hardware latency or process-memory guarantee

display_checks.bounds: owner visible area intersected with screen available geometry, including dialog frame
display_checks.candidate_table: at least one selectable data row remains visible in tested small configurations
display_checks.visual_inspection: pair cells, source tables, narrow layout and selected-pair reference lines inspected from Qt widget captures

limits: Native Windows/MSVC, macOS and packaged desktop validation remain pending
No output of a joint node or its descendants as a new paired input
Structural rewrites directly involving joint nodes remain restricted
No direct live linkage to a separately saved run; import it as a database source first
Offscreen captures do not test native window-manager focus, decorations or multi-monitor movement
reproduce: qmake -r Aster.pro CONFIG+=release CONFIG+=help_reference; build with the configured native toolchain
